svg.title: Stencil area ratio: the same small opening in a thick and a thin stencil
svg.desc: Enlarged and drawn to scale. Two cross-sections through a stencil opening 0.25 mm square, over a copper pad. In a 0.127 mm (5 mil) thick stencil the area ratio is 0.49, below the 0.66 minimum, so paste sticks to the walls instead of releasing onto the pad. In a 0.076 mm (3 mil) thick stencil the area ratio is 0.82, above the minimum, and the paste releases. Area ratio is the opening's area divided by the area of its walls.

g.text: Paste must grip the pad more
Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
Area ratio = opening area ÷ wall area; for a square opening, width ÷ (4 × thickness).
A thinner stencil helps the small part but gives every large part less paste (PCB-DFA-020).
